explainer.summary: WETH9 is a minimal ERC20 wrapper for Ether with fixed name/symbol/decimals and no owner or admin. Ether sent via fallback or deposit() increases the sender's balanceOf and emits Deposit; withdraw() burns wrapped balance and sends ETH back. totalSupply() reports the contract's ETH balance while approve/transfer/transferFrom implement standard token mechanics with special-case infinite allowance handling.

key_functions.name: deposit
key_functions.what: Increments balanceOf[msg.sender] by msg.value and emits Deposit.

key_functions.name: withdraw
key_functions.what: Requires sufficient balanceOf[msg.sender], subtracts wad, performs msg.sender.transfer(wad) and emits Withdrawal.

key_functions.name: totalSupply
key_functions.what: Returns this.balance (contract's ETH holdings).

key_functions.name: approve
key_functions.what: Sets allowance[msg.sender][guy] = wad and emits Approval.

key_functions.name: transfer
key_functions.what: Delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, dst, wad).

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: Checks src balance, optionally deducts from allowance (skipped if allowance[src][msg.sender] == uint(-1)), moves tokens and emits Transfer.

explainer.upgradeability: Not upgradeable; the contract contains no proxy, owner, or selfdestruct logic and its code is immutable after deployment.
user_risks: Direct ETH transfers to the contract without calling deposit still increase totalSupply but do not credit any user balance.
Allowance value of uint(-1) grants permanent infinite approval that cannot be reduced by transferFrom.
integration_tips: Call deposit() or send ETH to wrap; call withdraw(wad) to unwrap.
Check allowance[src][msg.sender] != uint(-1) before assuming a finite allowance can be reduced.
Use balanceOf and totalSupply exactly as defined; they are the only views provided.

explainer.summary: TetherToken.sol implements an ERC20 token with owner-controlled pause, blacklist, fee, mint/burn, and deprecation mechanisms. Transfers and approvals are blocked for blacklisted addresses or when paused, and can forward to an upgraded contract if deprecated. The owner address receives any transaction fees and holds all initial supply plus minting rights.

key_functions.name: transfer
key_functions.what: Moves tokens applying optional fee sent to owner; reverts if sender blacklisted or paused; forwards to upgraded contract if deprecated.

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: Moves tokens from allowance applying optional fee; reverts if from blacklisted or paused; forwards if deprecated.

key_functions.name: addBlackList
key_functions.what: Owner-only function that marks an address as blacklisted, blocking its transfers.

key_functions.name: destroyBlackFunds
key_functions.what: Owner-only function that zeros a blacklisted address balance and reduces totalSupply.

key_functions.name: pause
key_functions.what: Owner-only function that sets paused=true, blocking all transfers and transferFrom.

key_functions.name: issue
key_functions.what: Owner-only function that increases totalSupply and owner balance.

key_functions.name: redeem
key_functions.what: Owner-only function that decreases totalSupply and owner balance.

key_functions.name: deprecate
key_functions.what: Owner-only function that sets deprecated=true and records the upgradedAddress for future calls.

key_functions.name: setParams
key_functions.what: Owner-only function that sets basisPointsRate (<20) and maximumFee (<50) for transfer fees.

admin_powers: add or remove addresses from blacklist and destroy their funds
mint (issue) or burn (redeem) tokens to/from owner balance
set transfer fee parameters (basisPointsRate and maximumFee)
deprecate contract and redirect calls to a new upgraded address
explainer.upgradeability: Boolean deprecated flag plus upgradedAddress; when true, transfer/transferFrom/approve/balanceOf/allowance/totalSupply forward to UpgradedStandardToken at that address via transferByLegacy etc.
user_risks: owner can blacklist any address and permanently destroy its tokens
owner can pause all transfers indefinitely
owner can mint arbitrary new tokens or set non-zero transfer fees
contract can be deprecated, redirecting all calls to an external upgraded contract
integration_tips: Always check paused state and isBlackListed before relying on balances or transfers
Allowance approvals must be set to zero before changing non-zero values to avoid the documented race condition
Monitor Deprecate event to switch to the new contract address when deprecated becomes true

explainer.summary: FiatTokenV2_2 extends FiatTokenV2_1 and adds initializeV2_2 for symbol update plus migration of accounts from _deprecatedBlacklisted to the new balanceAndBlacklistStates structure (setting high bit for blacklist). It overrides _chainId, _domainSeparator (EIP712 version "2"), _setBlacklistState, _setBalance, _isBlacklisted and _balanceOf to pack blacklist flag with balance in the same storage slot, and exposes signature-based permit/transferWithAuthorization/receiveWithAuthorization/cancelAuthorization plus standard ERC20 overrides that all require whenNotPaused.

key_functions.name: initializeV2_2
key_functions.what: Requires _initializedVersion==2, sets symbol, migrates listed accounts from _deprecatedBlacklisted, blacklists self, sets _initializedVersion=3.

key_functions.name: permit
key_functions.what: whenNotPaused wrapper calling _permit with bytes signature (or v,r,s overload).

key_functions.name: transferWithAuthorization
key_functions.what: whenNotPaused notBlacklisted wrapper calling _transferWithAuthorization.

key_functions.name: receiveWithAuthorization
key_functions.what: whenNotPaused notBlacklisted wrapper calling _receiveWithAuthorization with payee==msg.sender check.

key_functions.name: cancelAuthorization
key_functions.what: whenNotPaused wrapper calling _cancelAuthorization.

key_functions.name: _setBlacklistState
key_functions.what: ORs (1<<255) or resets to _balanceOf on balanceAndBlacklistStates.

key_functions.name: _setBalance
key_functions.what: Reverts if > (2^255-1) or blacklisted, else stores in lower 255 bits.

key_functions.name: _isBlacklisted
key_functions.what: Returns true if high bit of balanceAndBlacklistStates[_account] is set.

key_functions.name: _balanceOf
key_functions.what: Returns lower 255 bits of balanceAndBlacklistStates[_account].

key_functions.name: approve
key_functions.what: whenNotPaused wrapper calling _approve.

explainer.upgradeability: Implementation contract; initializeV2_2 may be called only once when _initializedVersion==2 and advances it to 3 after blacklist migration and symbol change.
user_risks: Blacklisted accounts cannot transfer or have balances updated (high bit set).
All state-changing calls except cancelAuthorization require contract not paused.
Balances cannot exceed (2^255-1).
integration_tips: Use EIP-712 domain separator with name, "2", chainId for signature verification.
Call initializeV2_2 with previously blacklisted accounts when upgrading from V2_1.
Pack EOA signatures as r,s,v bytes for permit and authorization methods.

explainer.summary: Dai is an ERC20 token with authorization-controlled minting, burn/transfer logic that respects infinite allowances, and EIP-712 permit support. It inherits LibNote to emit LogNote events on rely/deny. The contract has no upgrade or proxy mechanisms and initializes wards[msg.sender] in the constructor.

key_functions.name: rely
key_functions.what: Grants ward status to an address when called by an existing ward (emits note).

key_functions.name: deny
key_functions.what: Revokes ward status from an address when called by an existing ward (emits note).

key_functions.name: mint
key_functions.what: Increases balance and totalSupply for a user; callable only by wards.

key_functions.name: burn
key_functions.what: Decreases balance and totalSupply after allowance check (unless infinite or self).

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: Moves tokens with allowance check that skips decrement on infinite allowance.

key_functions.name: approve
key_functions.what: Sets allowance and emits Approval.

key_functions.name: permit
key_functions.what: Sets infinite or zero allowance via EIP-712 signature after nonce/expiry checks.

key_functions.name: push
key_functions.what: Alias for transferFrom(msg.sender, usr, wad).

key_functions.name: pull
key_functions.what: Alias for transferFrom(usr, msg.sender, wad).

key_functions.name: move
key_functions.what: Alias for transferFrom(src, dst, wad).

explainer.upgradeability: No upgradeability; the contract contains no delegatecall, proxy, or implementation storage patterns.
user_risks: Allowance can be set to uint(-1) and is never decremented on transfers.
burn and transferFrom perform allowance checks only when src != msg.sender and allowance != uint(-1).
permit requires exact nonce match and reverts on replay or expiry.
integration_tips: Call permit before transferFrom when using gasless approvals.
Check for uint(-1) allowance to avoid unnecessary storage writes.
Use wards to determine mint authority rather than assuming msg.sender.

explainer.summary: UniswapV2Factory (constructor takes _feeToSetter) stores feeTo/feeToSetter and maintains getPair/allPairs mappings; createPair deploys a UniswapV2Pair via create2 with salt keccak256(token0,token1), calls initialize, and emits PairCreated. Only feeToSetter may call setFeeTo or setFeeToSetter; all other state changes occur inside the deployed Pair contracts.

key_functions.name: constructor
key_functions.what: sets feeToSetter to the supplied address

key_functions.name: createPair
key_functions.what: validates distinct non-zero tokens, deploys UniswapV2Pair via create2, initializes it, records the pair in both directions and allPairs, emits PairCreated

key_functions.name: setFeeTo
key_functions.what: sets feeTo only if caller == feeToSetter

key_functions.name: setFeeToSetter
key_functions.what: transfers feeToSetter only if caller == feeToSetter

key_functions.name: allPairsLength
key_functions.what: returns length of allPairs array

key_functions.name: getPair
key_functions.what: returns the stored pair address for the given token0/token1 ordering

admin_powers: feeToSetter may call setFeeTo and setFeeToSetter at any time
explainer.upgradeability: none (no proxy, delegatecall or upgrade logic present)
user_risks: feeToSetter is a single privileged address that can redirect protocol fees
createPair reverts if pair already exists or tokens are identical/zero
integration_tips: call getPair before createPair to avoid revert
use the canonical factory address to obtain the authoritative pair mapping
interact with pairs only through the factory-recorded addresses

explainer.summary: UniswapV2Router02 implements IUniswapV2Router02 and routes liquidity and swap operations to Uniswap V2 pairs via the factory. It stores immutable factory and WETH addresses set once in the constructor and uses the ensure modifier to enforce deadlines. All core logic delegates to UniswapV2Library for calculations and TransferHelper for token movements.

key_functions.name: addLiquidity
key_functions.what: Adds liquidity to a token pair after optionally creating the pair and transfers tokens to the pair before calling mint.

key_functions.name: addLiquidityETH
key_functions.what: Adds liquidity using ETH by wrapping to WETH then calling _addLiquidity and mint.

key_functions.name: removeLiquidity
key_functions.what: Transfers LP tokens to the pair then burns them and enforces minimum output amounts.

key_functions.name: swapExactTokensForTokens
key_functions.what: Transfers input tokens to the first pair then calls _swap to route exact input for minimum output.

key_functions.name: swapExactETHForTokens
key_functions.what: Wraps msg.value to WETH then performs a swap along the path starting with WETH.

key_functions.name: _swap
key_functions.what: Iterates the path executing pair.swap for each hop using precomputed amounts.

key_functions.name: _addLiquidity
key_functions.what: Computes optimal amounts using reserves or desired values and creates the pair if missing.

key_functions.name: removeLiquidityETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens
key_functions.what: Removes liquidity then transfers the token balance after fee-on-transfer handling.

explainer.upgradeability: Not upgradeable; factory and WETH are immutable and set only in the constructor.
user_risks: Transactions revert if deadline < block.timestamp via the ensure modifier.
Swaps and liquidity operations can fail with INSUFFICIENT_OUTPUT_AMOUNT or INSUFFICIENT_INPUT_AMOUNT if slippage exceeds limits.
Fee-on-transfer tokens require the SupportingFeeOnTransferTokens variants or balances may be incorrect.
integration_tips: Always pass a future deadline and set amountOutMin/amountAMin to protect against slippage.
Use the view functions getAmountsOut and getAmountsIn to pre-compute expected values before calling state-changing swaps.
When integrating ETH flows ensure msg.value matches the first path element when WETH is involved.

explainer.summary: SwapRouter is a stateless contract for executing exact-input and exact-output swaps against Uniswap V3 pools, supporting single-hop and multi-hop paths via the Path library. It inherits ISwapRouter, PeripheryImmutableState, PeripheryValidation, PeripheryPaymentsWithFee, Multicall and SelfPermit, with constructor taking factory and WETH9. All swaps go through pool.swap with callback validation and deadline checks; no owner or state-changing admin logic exists in the source.

key_functions.name: exactInputSingle
key_functions.what: executes single-hop exact-input swap with amountOutMinimum and deadline check

key_functions.name: exactInput
key_functions.what: executes multi-hop exact-input swap by iterating path segments and updating payer to address(this) after first hop

key_functions.name: exactOutputSingle
key_functions.what: executes single-hop exact-output swap, resets amountInCached after use

key_functions.name: exactOutput
key_functions.what: executes multi-hop exact-output swap using amountInCached from callback

key_functions.name: uniswapV3SwapCallback
key_functions.what: validates callback via CallbackValidation, pays tokenIn or continues exactOutputInternal for multi-pool paths

key_functions.name: multicall
key_functions.what: delegatecalls multiple encoded functions in one transaction, reverts with decoded string on failure

key_functions.name: selfPermit
key_functions.what: calls IERC20Permit.permit on token for the router

key_functions.name: unwrapWETH9
key_functions.what: withdraws WETH9 balance above minimum and transfers ETH to recipient

explainer.upgradeability: not upgradeable; deployed as immutable contract with no proxy or owner-controlled logic
user_risks: must supply sufficient deadline or transaction reverts with Transaction too old
amountOutMinimum / amountInMaximum must be respected or swap reverts
intermediate hops custody tokens at router address until final recipient
integration_tips: batch approvals and swaps with multicall + selfPermit* functions
set recipient to address(0) to receive intermediate outputs at router for multi-hop
use Path.encode and skipToken helpers when constructing multi-pool calldata

explainer.summary: Permit2 (src/Permit2.sol) inherits SignatureTransfer and AllowanceTransfer to provide a unified entrypoint for both signature-based token transfers (via permitTransferFrom and permitWitnessTransferFrom) and allowance-based transfers (via approve, permit, and transferFrom). It relies on EIP712 for domain separation with chainid caching and uses nonce bitmaps plus PackedAllowance for replay protection. Users must first approve the Permit2 contract on target ERC20 tokens before any transfer functions can succeed.

key_functions.name: approve
key_functions.what: Sets amount and expiration in allowance mapping for a token-spender pair.

key_functions.name: permit
key_functions.what: Verifies EIP-712 signature and calls _updateApproval for single or batch PermitDetails.

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: Pulls tokens using stored PackedAllowance, checking expiration and decrementing amount.

key_functions.name: lockdown
key_functions.what: Zeroes amount for multiple token-spender pairs for msg.sender.

key_functions.name: invalidateNonces
key_functions.what: Advances nonce in PackedAllowance after validating delta <= type(uint16).max.

key_functions.name: permitTransferFrom
key_functions.what: Verifies signature, consumes unordered nonce, and executes safeTransferFrom for single or batch TokenPermissions.

key_functions.name: permitWitnessTransferFrom
key_functions.what: Same as permitTransferFrom but includes witness hash for additional data.

key_functions.name: invalidateUnorderedNonces
key_functions.what: ORs mask into nonceBitmap for msg.sender at given wordPos.

explainer.upgradeability: Not upgradeable; constructor caches DOMAIN_SEPARATOR using immutable _CACHED_CHAIN_ID and _CACHED_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.
user_risks: Must approve Permit2 on every token before calling transfer functions.
SignatureExpired or AllowanceExpired reverts if deadlines or expirations are in the past.
InvalidNonce or InvalidAmount reverts on replay or exceeding permitted amounts.
lockdown and invalidateNonces permanently reduce or block future allowances/nonces.
integration_tips: Call DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() to obtain the current EIP-712 domain for off-chain signing.
Use permit before transferFrom when gasless approvals are desired.
Batch variants reduce calldata for multiple tokens in one signature.

explainer.summary: The Uni contract is a fixed-supply ERC20 token with 1B initial supply, controlled minting by a designated minter (capped at 2% per year after an initial delay), and built-in delegation for on-chain voting via checkpoints. It implements EIP-2612 permit and EIP-712 delegation signatures, using uint96 balances and SafeMath for all arithmetic. No proxy or upgrade logic is present in the source.

key_functions.name: mint
key_functions.what: Allows the current minter to create up to mintCap percent of totalSupply after mintingAllowedAfter, then updates the next allowed timestamp.

key_functions.name: setMinter
key_functions.what: Transfers the minter role to a new address; callable only by the existing minter.

key_functions.name: delegate
key_functions.what: Sets the caller's delegatee for voting power and moves existing balance votes.

key_functions.name: delegateBySig
key_functions.what: Delegates via EIP-712 signature, validating nonce, expiry and chainId.

key_functions.name: getPriorVotes
key_functions.what: Returns the vote balance for an account at a specific past block using binary search over checkpoints.

key_functions.name: permit
key_functions.what: Sets allowance via EIP-712 signature with deadline, updating nonces and emitting Approval.

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: Moves tokens while deducting allowance unless the allowance is max uint96.

key_functions.name: approve
key_functions.what: Sets allowance, supporting uint(-1) as infinite approval.

admin_powers: mint (only current minter, subject to time and cap)
explainer.upgradeability: none (no proxy, delegatecall, or upgrade functions in source)
user_risks: minting can increase totalSupply up to 2% per year after the initial delay
approve comment notes classic ERC20 race condition when changing allowances
balances and allowances are uint96; amounts exceeding 2^96-1 revert
integration_tips: Use getPriorVotes for governance snapshots rather than current balance
Call permit for gasless approvals before transferFrom
Track DelegateVotesChanged events for off-chain vote indexing
Check minimumTimeBetweenMints and mintCap before expecting new supply

explainer.summary: LinkToken is a fixed-supply ERC20 token (totalSupply=10**27) that mints the entire supply to the deployer in the constructor and extends ERC20 with ERC677 transferAndCall functionality. All transfers, approvals, and transferFrom calls are guarded by a validRecipient modifier that blocks the zero address and the token contract itself. The implementation uses SafeMath and includes increaseApproval/decreaseApproval helpers but contains no owner, mint, or burn logic after deployment.

key_functions.name: transfer
key_functions.what: Moves tokens from msg.sender to _to after validRecipient check, using SafeMath.

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: Moves tokens from _from to _to using allowance, after validRecipient check.

key_functions.name: approve
key_functions.what: Sets allowance for _spender after validRecipient check.

key_functions.name: transferAndCall
key_functions.what: Performs ERC20 transfer then calls onTokenTransfer on _to if it is a contract, after validRecipient check.

key_functions.name: increaseApproval
key_functions.what: Adds to the current allowance for _spender.

key_functions.name: decreaseApproval
key_functions.what: Subtracts from the current allowance for _spender, flooring at zero.

key_functions.name: balanceOf
key_functions.what: Returns the token balance of the given address.

key_functions.name: allowance
key_functions.what: Returns the remaining allowance from owner to spender.

explainer.upgradeability: Not upgradeable; the contract is deployed as a single immutable implementation with no proxy or delegatecall mechanisms.
user_risks: approve still permits the classic race-condition vector if a spender's allowance is non-zero when a new approve is issued.
transferAndCall will silently succeed even if the recipient contract's onTokenTransfer reverts, because the call is not checked for return value.
integration_tips: Call transferAndCall when sending tokens to a contract that implements ERC677Receiver to trigger onTokenTransfer.
Use increaseApproval/decreaseApproval instead of approve when the current allowance may be non-zero.
Never rely on the token contract itself as a recipient; validRecipient explicitly reverts such attempts.

explainer.summary: GnosisSafe v1.3.0 is a multisig wallet singleton (contracts/GnosisSafe.sol) deployed at 0xd9Db270c1B5E3Bd161E8c8503c55cEABeE709552 that proxies delegate to; its constructor sets threshold=1 with zero owners to make it unusable directly. Initialization occurs only via setup(_owners,_threshold,to,data,fallbackHandler,paymentToken,payment,paymentReceiver) which calls setupOwners, internalSetFallbackHandler, setupModules and optional handlePayment. All subsequent execution flows through execTransaction which encodes EIP-712 data, increments nonce, verifies signatures via checkNSignatures, optionally runs Guard checks, executes via Executor.execute and handles gas refunds.

key_functions.name: setup
key_functions.what: Initializes owners, threshold, fallback handler, modules and optional payment; emits SafeSetup.

key_functions.name: execTransaction
key_functions.what: Encodes transaction data, checks signatures, runs guard pre/post checks, executes call/delegatecall and emits success/failure with payment.

key_functions.name: checkNSignatures
key_functions.what: Validates required number of ECDSA, approved-hash or EIP-1271 contract signatures against owners mapping.

key_functions.name: encodeTransactionData
key_functions.what: Builds the EIP-712 SafeTx hash bytes used for signing and domainSeparator.

key_functions.name: approveHash
key_functions.what: Marks a tx hash as pre-approved by a registered owner for later signature use.

key_functions.name: setGuard
key_functions.what: Authorized-only setter that stores guard address in GUARD_STORAGE_SLOT.

key_functions.name: setFallbackHandler
key_functions.what: Authorized-only setter that stores handler in FALLBACK_HANDLER_STORAGE_SLOT.

key_functions.name: handlePayment
key_functions.what: Calculates and transfers ETH or ERC20 gas refund to tx.origin or refundReceiver.

explainer.upgradeability: Singleton contract intended solely as master copy for GnosisSafeProxy; no on-chain upgrade function exists in this file—new singleton requires new proxy deployment.
user_risks: Threshold of 0 or owners[] containing zero address reverts with GS001/GS026
DelegateCall operation can arbitrarily modify storage or selfdestruct the Safe
Guard or fallbackHandler can be set to malicious contracts that inspect or block transactions
Gas refunds are always paid even on ExecutionFailure
integration_tips: Always call setup exactly once through the proxy; direct calls to the singleton are disabled
Use getTransactionHash or encodeTransactionData off-chain to collect owner signatures
When estimating gas, requiredTxGas reverts with the gas value encoded in the revert string
Check that signatures length >= threshold*65 before calling execTransaction

explainer.summary: Multicall3 aggregates results from multiple function calls in one transaction and is backwards-compatible with Multicall and Multicall2. It defines Call, Call3, Call3Value, and Result structs and implements aggregate, tryAggregate, aggregate3, aggregate3Value plus several block/chain view helpers. All aggregate methods are payable and the contract contains no state variables, owner, or proxy logic.

key_functions.name: aggregate
key_functions.what: Executes an array of Call structs, requires every call to succeed, and returns blockNumber plus returnData array.

key_functions.name: tryAggregate
key_functions.what: Executes Call structs; if requireSuccess is true all must succeed, otherwise returns Result array with per-call success flags.

key_functions.name: tryBlockAndAggregate
key_functions.what: Calls tryAggregate and additionally returns current blockNumber and blockHash.

key_functions.name: blockAndAggregate
key_functions.what: Wrapper that calls tryBlockAndAggregate with requireSuccess=true.

key_functions.name: aggregate3
key_functions.what: Executes Call3 structs allowing per-call allowFailure flag; reverts with 'Multicall3: call failed' when a required call fails.

key_functions.name: aggregate3Value
key_functions.what: Executes Call3Value structs, forwards per-call value, accumulates and checks total msg.value, reverts on value mismatch or disallowed failure.

key_functions.name: getEthBalance
key_functions.what: Returns the ETH balance of the supplied address using addr.balance.

key_functions.name: getBlockHash
key_functions.what: Returns blockhash(blockNumber) for the given block number.

key_functions.name: getChainId
key_functions.what: Returns block.chainid.

explainer.upgradeability: Not upgradeable; the contract has no owner, proxy, or delegatecall upgrade mechanisms.
user_risks: External calls use raw call so target contracts can execute arbitrary code and re-enter the caller.
aggregate and blockAndAggregate revert the entire transaction if any sub-call fails.
aggregate3Value reverts if msg.value does not exactly equal the sum of Call3Value.value fields.
integration_tips: Prefer aggregate3 when partial failures are acceptable via the allowFailure flag.
Use aggregate3Value when any sub-call must receive ETH.
All aggregate functions are payable even when no value is needed, saving 24 gas per call as noted in the NatSpec.

explainer.summary: ENSRegistryWithFallback inherits from ENSRegistry and adds fallback logic to an immutable old ENS contract for any node where recordExists returns false. Overrides of owner, resolver and ttl delegate to old when the node is absent from the local records mapping; _setOwner is overridden to store address(this) instead of address(0). The root node owner is set to the deployer in the ENSRegistry constructor.

key_functions.name: constructor
key_functions.what: Takes ENS _old, calls ENSRegistry constructor and stores _old in the public old variable.

key_functions.name: resolver
key_functions.what: Returns old.resolver(node) when !recordExists(node), otherwise super.resolver(node).

key_functions.name: owner
key_functions.what: Returns old.owner(node) when !recordExists(node), otherwise super.owner(node); super.owner returns address(0) for the contract itself.

key_functions.name: ttl
key_functions.what: Returns old.ttl(node) when !recordExists(node), otherwise super.ttl(node).

key_functions.name: setOwner
key_functions.what: Authorised modifier check then calls _setOwner and emits Transfer.

key_functions.name: setSubnodeOwner
key_functions.what: Authorised check, computes subnode, calls _setOwner, emits NewOwner and returns subnode.

key_functions.name: recordExists
key_functions.what: Returns true if records[node].owner != address(0).

key_functions.name: _setOwner
key_functions.what: Internal: stores owner or address(this) if the supplied owner is address(0).

admin_powers: Deployer is set as owner of the root node 0x0
Any node owner (or approved operator) may call setOwner, setSubnodeOwner, setResolver, setTTL and setRecord on nodes they control
explainer.upgradeability: No proxy or upgrade mechanism; only a one-way fallback to the immutable old ENS contract for unmigrated records.
user_risks: Unmigrated records depend on the old contract remaining available and correct
Zero-address owner is rewritten to the registry itself, preventing explicit zero owners
integration_tips: Check recordExists(node) before assuming a record is fully migrated
Use the same ENS interface for calls; the fallback is transparent for getters

explainer.summary: Seaport contract at the given address inherits from Consideration and implements version 1.5 marketplace logic for native/ERC20/721/1155 orders. Constructor accepts conduitController address and passes it to parent; _name and _nameString are overridden to return Seaport via assembly and string respectively. No other functions are defined in Seaport.sol itself.

key_functions.name: constructor
key_functions.what: Accepts conduitController address and calls Consideration constructor

key_functions.name: _name
key_functions.what: Internal pure function returning contract name via assembly mstore/return

key_functions.name: _nameString
key_functions.what: Internal pure function returning 'Seaport' string

key_functions.name: _transfer
key_functions.what: Internal function routing NATIVE/ERC20/ERC721/ERC1155 transfers based on itemType

key_functions.name: _transferNativeTokens
key_functions.what: Internal function performing native token call with revert on failure

key_functions.name: _transferERC20
key_functions.what: Internal function handling ERC20 transfer or conduit accumulator insert

key_functions.name: _transferERC721
key_functions.what: Internal function enforcing amount==1 then direct or conduit ERC721 transfer

key_functions.name: _transferERC1155
key_functions.what: Internal function performing direct or conduit ERC1155 transfer

key_functions.name: _trigger
key_functions.what: Internal function calling conduit with accumulated transfers then disarming accumulator

explainer.upgradeability: No upgradeability; constructor sets immutable state with no proxy or delegate patterns present in source.
user_risks: Reentrancy possible if external calls (e.g. conduit) re-enter protected functions
Native transfer failures revert with NativeTokenTransferGenericFailure
integration_tips: Pass conduitController to constructor for batched transfers
Use conduitKey=0 for direct approvals on Seaport
Accumulator must be managed to batch conduit calls

explainer.summary: Lido.sol implements the core liquid staking pool for stETH, accepting ETH via submit/fallback, tracking buffered/CL balances via storage slots, and processing oracle reports to rebase shares while handling withdrawals/EL rewards. It inherits Versioned + StETHPermit + AragonApp, uses locator for external contracts, enforces staking limits/pauses via roles, and supports v2 upgrade via finalizeUpgrade_v2. All logic is derived strictly from the provided source including handleOracleReport, deposit, and role-gated admin functions.
